risk_description: Peak ocean and air freight costs run above budget as Asia-UK capacity tightens
mitigation: Fix peak ocean rates with carriers; shift non-urgent volume to rail; cap air freight approvals
trigger_point: Freight cost per unit more than 10% over budget for two consecutive weeks

risk_description: Warm autumn weakens knitwear and outerwear demand, leaving Q4 revenue below the low end of the range
mitigation: Pull forward markdowns; cut re-order open-to-buy; targeted promotions
trigger_point: Weekly like-for-like sales more than 5% below plan for three weeks

risk_description: Deeper Black Friday promotions from competitors force margin dilution
mitigation: Selective price matching; protect top margin lines; shift spend to owned channels
trigger_point: Competitor discount depth above 30% on top 20 lines

risk_description: Southern Vietnam port closure delays peak stock and loses sales of Vietnam-origin lines
mitigation: Alternate port, air freight standby and buffer stock on top Vietnam lines
trigger_point: Port closure or typhoon landfall forecast within 7 days

risk_description: Sterling falls 8% against the dollar; 45% of USD purchases are unhedged
trigger_point: GBP/USD below 1.20 for five trading days

risk_description: New tariffs or export controls on China-origin goods raise landed costs
mitigation: Dual source top China categories; renegotiate cost prices; limited near-term mitigation
trigger_point: UK or US announces tariffs on China-origin electricals or apparel

risk_description: National living wage and energy cost increases at DCs and stores
mitigation: Labour scheduling optimisation; fixed-price energy contract
trigger_point: Wage and energy cost run-rate above budget for two months
